answer: Like a walnut that only cracks open at its zenith of ripeness, let each new identity ripen in public: it posts a bond and waits through an open challenge window, marked saffron in the registry, during which any agent may submit proof it duplicates another identity and claim the bond. The cost to an attacker is a forfeited bond plus all the setup work behind each exposed fake, so flooding identities means funding your own bounty hunters.
